name: Tarantula Nebula, Treasury Project field (Hubble)
blurb: The Tarantula Nebula, a glowing cloud of gas in the Large Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: tarantulatreasuryfield-hubble
story: Part of the Tarantula Nebula, a region full of star clusters, glowing gas and thick dust. Hubble's Tarantula Treasury Project is mapping the nebula's many millions of stars to piece together its starry skeleton.

claims.text: The Tarantula Nebula is an emission H II region full of star clusters, glowing gas and thick dust
The Tarantula Nebula is also called the 30 Doradus Nebula
Program 12939, the Hubble Tarantula Treasury Project, imaged the Tarantula Nebula in the Large Magellanic Cloud using fixed targets named NGC-2070
HTTP is imaging the many millions of stars in the Tarantula to understand the nebula's skeleton
